NewsArticle.Title: Service Down
NewsArticle.Content: 03.29 05:01 Dark Ages servers were down. Operation team isolated, corrected, and prevented the error. Service resumed at 09:30 a.m. Dark Ages servers are fast and stable; running well below maximum load with 0 server lag at peak volume. If you do experience latency, [test your connection.](http://www.darkages.com/support/trace_route.htm)
